story_retell.text: You will hear a short story. Listen carefully, and then retell it in your own words, as many details as you remember. Here is the story. Maria kept the lamp at the old harbor. Every evening she climbed forty steps to light it. One stormy night a small fishing boat lost its way. The boy on board, named Tomas, held a red scarf. Maria saw the boat from her window and rang the big bell. She also waved the lamp three times. The fishermen turned toward the rocks on the left, but the waves pushed them back. So Maria ran down to the pier with a rope. Her neighbor, a baker named Oleg, helped her pull the boat in. Everyone was cold, so they went to the bakery for hot bread and soup. In the morning the sea was calm. Tomas gave his scarf to Maria as a thank you. She tied it to the lamp, and it stayed there for many years.

picture_description.text: Look at the picture on the screen. It shows a street scene on a rainy afternoon, with several people, a dog, and a bus. Describe aloud what you see in the picture. Say who is there, what each person is doing, what the weather is like, and what is happening around them. Speak in full sentences and take your time. Then tell me what you think may happen next. If you notice something unusual or funny in the picture, mention it too. You can describe the details on the left, on the right, and in the middle. When you have finished, say that you are done. Now look at the second picture, a backyard on a windy day, and describe it in the same way.

Keep going until the time is up. Think of animals in the forest, on the farm, in the sea, in the desert, and in the sky. Ready? Time starts now.

naming_from_definition.text: I will describe an object, and you name it with one word. Listen. You write on paper with it. It has a thin core inside, and you hold it in your hand. What is it called? Next object. It hangs on the wall. It shows the time and it has two hands. What is it called? Next object. You open it with a key, and people walk through it to enter a room or a house. What is it called? Next. It is a yellow fruit with a thick peel, and monkeys like it. What is it called? Next. You wear it on your head when it is cold, and it is often made of wool. What is it called? Say the word aloud after each description.

describe_daily_routine.text: Tell me about your usual day. When do you get up, what do you do in the morning, what are you busy with in the afternoon, and how do you spend the evening? Speak slowly, in detail, in full sentences. You can say what you eat for breakfast, where you go, whom you meet, and what you like best about the day. You can also tell me about the weekend, and how it is different from a weekday. If you remember something funny or pleasant that happened recently, tell me about it. Take your time. I am listening. Begin when you are ready, and speak for about a minute.

read_aloud_short_text.text: Read the short text on the screen aloud. Read slowly and clearly. Here it is. In autumn the days get shorter. Yellow leaves fall from the trees, and in the morning a thin fog stands over the river. People take out their warm jackets and drink tea with honey. Children walk to school with bright umbrellas, and the old man in the park feeds the ducks with bread. In the evening the lamps come on early, and the windows glow warm and yellow. Smoke rises from the chimneys, and the smell of fresh bread comes from the small bakery on the corner. Now read the text aloud. Take your time and say each word clearly.
